title: Tailscale Connection Path
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Step through how two devices behind home routers build an encrypted connection, then predict paths and sort messages by plane.

educational.topic: Remote Access, SSH, and Mesh VPN Concepts
learningObjectives: The learner will explain how two devices behind NAT build an encrypted connection by predicting the path for 3 scenarios and assigning 3 messages to the coordination plane or the data plane, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: A relay forwards every packet of a relayed connection. Explain why it still cannot read them.
commonMisconceptions: The coordination service carries or can read the traffic.
A relay can read the traffic it forwards.
Two devices behind routers can never connect directly.
A relayed connection is not encrypted.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
